prompts.title: Q: Staged vs stageless?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** **Stageless** carries full capability in one blob; **stager** is a **tiny** loader that **downloads** the rest-useful when **exploit** space is **tight**.

prompts.title: Q: Why encode shellcode?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** To avoid **bad characters** (e.g., **null** terminators) in **protocols** or **vulnerable** **filters**, and to **evade** naive **signatures**.

---

prompts.title: Q: What breaks pure signature detection?
Q: Interviewer asks for exact shellcraft bytes—what do you do?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** Decline **weaponized** detail; offer **conceptual** **stages**, **mitigations**, and **detection** **tradeoffs**-appropriate for **defensive** roles.
